title: CreateVolumeRequest
description: Request body for creating a new Fly Volume.

size_gb.description: Size of the volume in gigabytes.

region.description: The region code where the volume should be created.

encrypted.description: Whether to encrypt the volume at rest. Defaults to true.

unique_zones_only.description: When true, ensures this volume is placed in a separate availability zone from other volumes with the same name in the app.

snapshot_id.description: Restore the volume from this snapshot ID during creation.

snapshot_retention.description: Number of days to retain snapshots. Defaults to 5.
